page.content:
Jade Gate oasis and the cave-library of the eastern road.

How Dunhuang connects

  • Location: Mogao Caves — The Mogao Caves are cut into the cliffs at Dunhuang.
  • Location: Hexi Corridor — Dunhuang sits at the west end of the Hexi Corridor.
  • Event: Buddhism transmission — Dunhuang's caves record Buddhism's long halt on the eastern road.

What is Dunhuang?

Dunhuang sits where the Hexi Corridor meets the Tarim split. The Mogao Caves record the Buddhist, Sogdian, and Chinese traffic that paused there.

Key threads lead to Mogao Caves, Hexi Corridor and Buddhism transmission.
